data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Change ID generation from 8-hex to 16-hex format. Makes T1 tests pass.

Implementation:
- Change: ticket_id = u[:4]+'-'+u[4:8]
- To: ticket_id = u[:4]+'-'+u[4:8]+'-'+u[8:12]+'-'+u[12:16]
- Update event filename pattern to match new 16-hex format
- Update CREATE event ticket_id field
- Update all internal references within ticket-create.sh

Dual-output stdout (SC3):
- First line: human summary 'Created ticket <alias>: <title>'
- Last line: canonical 16-hex ID (machine-parseable; consumers must use | tail -1)

depends_on: T1 (8986-4be4)
Story DD coverage: SC1 (16-hex), SC3 (dual-output stdout)
Retry budget: 2 attempts
data.title: GREEN: widen canonical ID to 16 hex chars in ticket-create.sh
